implementation.pose_candidates: Point-localization sets plus every supplied association assignment produce continuous SE2 outer boxes. No residual ranking or nearest-own-prediction selection. Missing/hidden identity, localization or angle coverage remains an explicit unknown branch. Overflow/cap failure never prunes aliases to pass.
implementation.continuous_transport: Exact rational Taylor remainders and Lipschitz bounds enclose sin/cos; outward interval arithmetic encloses inverse images of WHOLE target cells. Every touched source cell must be direct eligible across EVERY box. Current grass/object vetoes apply.
implementation.semantic_pruning: Reject an entire box only if one old asphalt cell center is mapped into current grass for EVERY pose in the box. Unknown materials, cropped/opaque regions and invalid poses cannot be used as pruning evidence.
implementation.refinement: Closed eight-way theta/tx/ty splits retain exact coverage. Capacity overflow preserves ALL coarse boxes. Two rounds tighten numerical enclosures without inventing tighter physical error bounds.
implementation.source_lineage: Frame hash, original pixel coordinates/value, quantized gray, preprocessing sampling support and masks are retained. Conditional gray eligibility is separate from whole-cell material/certificate status. Private images, center sets, poses and coordinates remain outside repository.

public_checks.mixture_scope: Official preprocessing and palette reproduced. Same output gray100 and threshold/erosion/flatness acceptance can occur with no source asphalt in a synthetic red/white patch. This is not an indistinguishable full image or a full HAIC-track counterexample.

existing_checkpoint_results.older_frame_ambiguity: Older conditional sets retain reversed-orientation/crop branches. The latest pair still spans approximately16.1degrees; no arbitrary short-time yaw bound was added.
existing_checkpoint_results.flow_bound_scope: Coordinate-wise outer relaxation of the existing0.25m radial residual gate; this tolerance is not promoted to an absolute correspondence-error bound.

decision: NO PROMOTION: even the conditional common mask does not repair the failing static footprint margin. Actual material/localization/association coverage is also unproved. No Agent edit or unchanged-source repeat reset.

next_concrete_alternative.raw_pixel_inverse: Use the public forward preprocessing model on local road/paint/grass boundary hypotheses; retain every compatible geometry/material assignment and its source-cell provenance. Certify a road cell only if every compatible hypothesis supports it, instead of promoting eroded gray labels.
next_concrete_alternative.orientation_and_identity: Feed the resulting independently observed boundary-orientation/localization intervals into this pose-box engine. Preserve reverse/crop/object aliases until they are contradicted; a second identified noncollinear landmark or a source-justified short-time reachable set could remove the remaining branches.
next_concrete_alternative.promotion_sequence: First obtain a useful common region and pass the unchanged static footprint gate; only then perform cached original-controller admission and final-source reset with wholeact5s. No physics/objective/safety/horizon/planner change.

scope: Implemented observer diagnostics and falsification gates, not a new production observer, completed race, or true-state safety certificate.
